sn11.17:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ Jetavane || || Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno || || Atha kho Sakko ca devānam indo Brahmā ca sahampati yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paccekadvārabāhaṃ nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu || || Atha kho Sakko devānam indo Bhagavato santike imaṃ Gātham abhāsi || ||
sn11.17:2.1: Uṭṭhāhi vīra vijitasaṅgāma || pannabhāra anaṇa vicara loke cittaṃ ca te suvimuttaṃ || cando yathā pannarasāya rattin ti || ||
sn11.17:3.1: Na kho devānam inda Tathāgatā evaṃ vanditabbā || evañ ca kho devānam inda Tathagatā vanditabbā || ||
sn11.17:4.1: Uṭṭhāhi vīra vijitasaṅgāma || satthavāha anaṇa vicara loke || desetu Bhagavā dhammam aññātāro bhavissantī ti || ||
